scoring.finding: Downloaded using the page-observed index. PDF title “Marble Fountain,” author Jonathan Crosmer, copyright 2016. Inspected score text and visible first-page instrumentation: Viola 1 through Viola 8 all have staves; the score continues to its final system on page 2. This is the original eight-viola version, not a transcription. Eight separate parts are also individually listed on IMSLP but were not downloaded because the complete score is sufficient.
